# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a stout woman weighing two hundred pounds who waddles when she walks.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a capable and notable housewife who manages her own concerns and those of her neighbors. She is extremely outspoken, inquisitive, and prided on always speaking her mind without fear or favor. Though known as a meddlesome gossip who freely dispenses unasked advice, she possesses a very kind heart, helps the poor, and never shirks her share of community work.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived at Lynde's Hollow where she closely observed all happenings along the Avonlea main road. When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert decided to adopt a boy, she expressed strong disapproval of the foolish risk, and was astonished when a girl named Anne Shirley arrived instead. Upon meeting Anne, Rachel bluntly criticized her red hair and skinny appearance, provoking a passionate outburst from the child. After Anne offered a dramatic and thorough apology, Rachel forgave her and grew to like her. Throughout Anne's school years, Rachel frequently gave advice on her upbringing and cautioned Marilla against modern innovations. Following the death of her husband, Thomas Lynde, Rachel faced the necessity of selling her mortgaged farm. Rather than leave Avonlea to live with her daughter, she accepted Marilla Cuthbert's invitation to move into Green Gables, allowing Anne to attend Redmond College while Rachel kept Marilla company.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), [v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_

## Quotes

> Well, Marilla, I’ll just tell you plain that I think you’re doing a mighty foolish thing—a risky thing, that’s what.  <sub>[v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)</sub>

> She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots!  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>

> There, there, get up, child. Of course I forgive you. I guess I was a little too hard on you, anyway. But I’m such an outspoken person.  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>

> You’ve got as much education now as a woman can be comfortable with. I don’t believe in girls going to college with the men and cramming their heads full of Latin and Greek and all that nonsense.  <sub>[v1 c38 P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031)</sub>

> I’m not an encyclopedia, neither am I a Philadelphia lawyer.  <sub>[v2 c26 P29](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0029)</sub>
